svg.title: Decision capacity: Laya alone decides over up to 150 measured options and cannot run at 10,000; MahaBodi decides over 5.9 million pages out of the box
svg.text: out of the box: memory + retrieval + decision
Height = options per decision, not accuracy. Accuracy (AIDA entity linking): at 100K MahaBodi beats Laya + dense (0.177 vs 0.121);
at 5.9M it ties it (0.103 vs 0.122, 8.3 s per decision), and a remembered alias prior beats both (0.77). Details: BENCHMARKS.md.
